name: wcag-encyclopedia
description: A visual encyclopedia of WCAG 2.2 — every Level A and AA criterion, shown rather than described.

scripts.build: vite build && vite build --ssr src/entry-server.tsx --outDir dist-ssr && node scripts/prerender.mjs
scripts.test:a11y: playwright test; s=$?; node scripts/flaky.mjs; exit $s
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run test:a11y
scripts.verify:changed: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && playwright test --only-changed=labs --pass-with-no-tests
